CITY OF SAN GABRIEL
  COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION

  425 South Mission Drive

How to Submit Public Comment:
Members of the Public who wish to submit public comment may do so using one of the following
methods. Public comment is limited to the time allotted.

In-Person: Complete a Speaker Card, indicating the agenda item number and submit it to the City Clerk
prior to the meeting. Speakers shall be limited to three (3) minutes per person per item. At the Chair’ s
discretion, the time limit may be shortened to allow all speakers to address the Community Services
Commission.

Website: Electronic submission of Public Comment is available via the City’s website as noted below. Public
Comment submitted electronically by 4:00 P.M. on the meeting day will be forwarded to the Commission
before the meeting for their consideration but will not be read during the meeting. Comments submitted
after 4:00 P.M. will be forwarded to Commission but may not be received before the meeting.

Website: Please submit your comments using the online public comment form at Public Comment.

Watch the Meeting Online
Live broadcasts of the meetings are available using the following link:
Community Services Commission Videos

Spectrum cable: Live streaming on Channel 3, Public Access Channel.
   COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION AGENDA
  Wednesday, October 15, 2025

  •  CALL TO ORDER
  •  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE LED BY: Commissioner Cabot
  •  ROLL CALL: Commissioner Cabot, Commissioner Duong, Commissioner Huang,
  Vice Chair Rodriguez, and Chair Barrantes

  1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

  2. PUBLIC COMMENT

  3. ACTION ITEMS

  4. DISCUSSION ITEMS

  A. FOCUS GROUP DISCUSSION REGARDING THE MISSION PLAYHOUSE
  STRATEGIC PLAN

  Arts Consulting Group will facilitate a discussion with the commissioners and
  members of the public attending the meeting to develop a strategic plan for
  the Mission Playhouse. The plan will assess the status of the Mission
  Playhouse, chart a clear direction for the future and develop a comprehensive
  strategic plan, including operational priorities and an implementation
  roadmap.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends the commission actively engage with the Arts Consulting
  Group to aid in their development of a strategic plan.

  5. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regular Community Services Commission meeting will be held on
  Monday November 3, 2025, at 6:30 P.M. Information regarding matters to be
  considered at each meeting will be available on the Friday before the Community
  Services Commission Meeting on the City’s website at www.sangabrielcity.com.

 Materials Available for Inspection. You may view agenda items online at
 www.sangabrielcity.com/agendacenter. Materials related to an item on this Agenda,
 submitted to the Community Services Commission after distribution of the Agenda
 packet, will be posted on the City website.

  Persons with Disabilities. Upon request, this Agenda will be made available in

 Persons requesting a Translator. Any person requesting translation for the meeting

 English
 Translation Services. Upon request, the agenda and any public hearing notice for a
 project may be translated in either Chinese, Spanish, or Vietnamese. Please direct such
 a request for translation to the Community Services Department by emailing
 cscommission@sgch.org at least 48 hours before the meeting.

 Vietnamese
 Dịch vụ Dịch thuật. Theo yêu cầu, chương trình nghị sự và bất kỳ thông báo điều trần
 công khai nào cho một dự án có thể được dịch sang tiếng Trung, tiếng Tây Ban Nha

 Spanish

 Questions about this Agenda? Should any person have a question concerning any of
 the above Agenda items prior to the meeting, please contact the City Clerk at
 cscommission@sgch.org during regular office hours.
